capabilities: Highlight files with unfinished tasks in the File Explorer
Generate a vault-wide summary note of all unfinished tasks
Sync task completion between the summary and source notes
Configure highlight color, glow, bold text, and dot indicator
Show the count of matching notes in the status bar
extras: Manual installation only (download manifest.json, main.js, styles.css from GitHub Releases); README warns the highlight may override the File Color plugin's colors; all processing is local.
problem: Obsidian gives no at-a-glance indication of which notes still contain incomplete tasks, so unfinished work is easy to miss across a vault.
summary: Task tracker that highlights files containing unfinished Markdown tasks in the File Explorer and keeps a vault-wide unfinished task summary note.
